title: Insecure Design
description: Muspelheim demonstrates insecure design through a trading system with race conditions and business logic flaws in flash loan handling.
theme: Norse realm of fire - symbolizing the rapid, chaotic nature of race conditions

endpoints.description: Withdrawal endpoint with race condition between balance check and update
Flash loan with premature collateral release

vulnerabilities.description: The trading system has a TOCTOU race condition in the withdrawal logic. Balance is checked, then an async delay occurs before the update, allowing concurrent requests to bypass the check.
vulnerabilities.impact: Users can withdraw more funds than available balance. Multiple concurrent requests can drain account beyond limits.
exploit_steps: Deposit initial funds to get a positive balance
Exploit the time gap between balance check and update
Accumulate more funds than should be possible
Access vault when balance exceeds threshold
exploit_indicators: Withdrawal amount greater than current balance
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use database transactions with row-level locking. Implement optimistic locking with version numbers. Use atomic operations for balance updates. Add distributed locks for critical sections.

endpoints.description: Flash loan releases collateral before verifying repayment

vulnerabilities.description: Flash loan system releases collateral immediately, then checks repayment after. This violates secure transaction ordering.
vulnerabilities.impact: Users can obtain funds without proper collateral. Business logic can be exploited to gain unauthorized access.
exploit_steps: Receive funds immediately as collateral is released first
System checks repayment after funds are already available
Exploit the reversed order of operations
exploit_indicators: Loan marked active before collateral check
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement proper transaction ordering. Verify all preconditions before state changes. Use formal verification for critical business logic. Implement proper state machine for loan lifecycle.

flags.retrieval_method: Exploit race condition to achieve impossible balance, access vault

learning_objectives: Learn about transaction ordering in secure systems

expected_response.notes: Should allow over-withdrawal if race condition exists
